messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "The model that observes all three sources of information (images, questions, and answers) performs the best on the COCOQA dataset when considering the combined accuracy of identifying irrelevant image-question pairs (IU) and irrelevant question-answer pairs (QU)." -- cites: E2 (Section Table 8): quote "MLP-IQA 93.1 78.3 75.9"
2. "The model that only observes answers (MLP-A) performs significantly worse than the model that observes all three sources of information (MLP-IQA) on the COCOQA dataset." -- cites: E2 (Section Table 8): quote "MLP-A 70.3 31.7 26.6"; E2 (Section Table 8): quote "MLP-IQA 93.1 78.3 75.9"
3. "The model that only observes answers (MLP-A) attains about the chance-level accuracy on the COCOQA dataset." -- cites: E2 (Section Table 8): quote "MLP-A 70.3 31.7 26.6"
4. "The model that observes only images and answers (MLP-IA) performs better than the model that only observes answers (MLP-A) but worse than the model that observes all three sources of information (MLP-IQA) on the COCOQA dataset." -- cites: E2 (Section Table 8): quote "MLP-IA 73.4 73.3 60.7"; E2 (Section Table 8): quote "MLP-IQA 93.1 78.3 75.9"

Cited evidence:
[E2] (text, Section Table 8, page 15): Table 8: Test accuracy (%) on COCOQA. Method IoU QoU IoU +QoU MLP-A 70.3 31.7 26.6 MLP-IA 73.4 73.3 60.7 MLP-QA 91.5 52.5 51.4 MLP-IQA 93.1 78.3 75.9 Random 25.0 25.0 14.3

verdicts.reason: The claim mentions 'combined accuracy' but the evidence only provides accuracy for 'IoU', 'QoU', and 'IoU +QoU'. The evidence does not provide combined accuracy for all three sources of information.
The evidence shows that MLP-IQA has higher accuracy (93.1, 78.3, 75.9) than MLP-A (70.3, 31.7, 26.6) for 'IoU', 'QoU', and 'IoU +QoU' respectively.
The evidence shows that MLP-A has an accuracy of 70.3 for 'IoU', which is close to the chance-level accuracy of 25.0 provided in the table.
The evidence shows that MLP-IA has an accuracy of 73.4 for 'IoU', which is higher than MLP-A (70.3) but lower than MLP-IQA (93.1) for 'IoU'.
